findings.nomination_reason: Inventory changes can originate from several documented actions and are reflected in multiple documented outputs, so the handling needed to keep those representations consistent should be checked.
findings.evidence_reason: The finding is anchored in FR-008, which explicitly relates cart and order actions to automatic inventory-level updates and identifies updated product listings and inventory reports as outputs.
findings.coverage_reason: FR-008 already specifies the equivalent consistency response: inventory levels are automatically updated when items are added to or removed from carts or ordered. FR-016 additionally requires inventory updates after payment. The document therefore already covers synchronization for the documented inventory-changing events.
findings.boundary_reason: Inventory tracking, updating, and presentation through product listings and reports are documented responsibilities of the target system.
